Claim 1 (Currently Amended): A composite stiffener, comprising: first, second and third members formed from laminated composite tape, the first and second members defining a web and flanges extending from the web, and the third member being joined to the flanges and extending generally transverse to the web, the first, second and third composite members intersecting to form a void; a filler disposed in and substantially filling the void; at least one layer of composite fabric on each of the members in the area of the filler; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric.

Claim 2 (Currently Amended): The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the first and second members include radius areas between the web and each of the flanges, and the fabric layer covers the radius areas, wherein the layer of adhesive includes a folded sheet of structural adhesive.

Claim 5 (Currently Amended): The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of adhesive and the at least one layer of composite fabric extend beyond the radius areas into adjacent regions.

Claim 6 (Currently Amended): The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric of the composite members are positioned with respect to each other such that they exhibit at least one offset relative to each other.

Claim 7 (Currently Amended): A composite stiffener, comprising: a pair of composite channels joined together, each of the channels including a web, flanges extending from the web, radius areas between the web and each of the flanges; a base extending transverse to the web and joined to each of the flanges, the radius areas of the channels and the base forming at least one radius filler zone; a reinforcing member filling the radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the channels and the base; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric layer.

Claim 11 (Currently Amended): The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the filler is one of: a formed unidirectional composite tape, a composite laminate, a hybrid tape-fabric member, and a titanium member, and wherein the composite fabric layer includes three composite patches respectively on each of the channels and the base.

Claim 13 (Currently Amended): The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive includes a sheet of structural adhesive wrapped around the filler, and the adhesive extends beyond the radius filler zone into interfacial layers between the channels and between the base and each of the flanges.

Claim 25 (Currently Amended): A composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: an I-section structure formed of laminated composite tape plies in an area between the web and the flanges; the structure including a web, a pair of flanges on each end of the web, and radius areas between the web and the flanges, with a cap being joined to the first set of flanges and the base being joined to the second set of flanges, the cap and the base each intersecting the web in the radius areas to define a radius filler zone; a reinforcing filler in the radius filler zone; and a layer of adhesive joining the filler to the composite fabric in the radius filler zone.
